column1: AN  ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN AESTHETIC AND
RESEARCH CENTRE CALLED “THE AMARADEVA AESTHETIC AND
RESEARCH CENTRE” IN GRATITUDE OF THE LEGENDARY MUSIC ICON IN
SRI  LANKA,  LATE  PANDITH  WANNAKUWATTAWADUGE  DON
AMARADEVA; TO SPECIFY ITS OBJECTS AND POWERS AND TO PROVIDE
FOR THE MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
